label: digit 1 input mid-way through the original phase
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, mostly at steps t=2..5 (peak at t=3), and never on the delimiter or copy phase. The input token 1 dominates: 13.9x lift, 55% of activation mass, and all of the top activations (about 0.9-1.0 of max) are a 1 at t=3 that follows a prefix such as z/f/o/j. Weaker activations come on x, m, n, f and 0 inputs, and the rate goes up with the number of digits in the sequence. Prefix context matters: a 1 at t=7-8, or one after a prefix of other letters (e.g. y l w x q a c 1), usually does not fire. Predicate: a 1 input at t in 2..6 after at least one prefix token from {z,f,o,j,1,x,0,3,m,t}. Dev P=0.51, R=0.39, mass recall 0.52. Adding the x/m/n/f inputs (with two or more of those prefix tokens seen) raises mass recall to 0.86, but precision drops to 0.31. The context dependence looks distributed, and no clean rule captures it.
